parameter-group.name: model
parameter-group.label: Model
parameter-group.description: Select the Parakeet model and configure model loading behavior.

parameter-group.name: transcription
parameter-group.label: Transcription Behavior
parameter-group.description: Configure transcription mode, decoder, language, and utterance handling.

parameter-group.name: recognition
parameter-group.label: Audio Stream & Stopping Limits
parameter-group.description: Configure audio chunking and silence or duration timeouts for the audio stream.

parameter-group.name: vad
parameter-group.label: Voice Activity Detection
parameter-group.description: Configure the Silero Voice Activity Detector used to detect and segment speech.

parameter-group.name: performance
parameter-group.label: CPU Performance
parameter-group.description: Configure CPU threading and backend concurrency for model inference.

parameter.name: modelName
parameter.label: Model Name
parameter.description: ASR model or bundle GGUF file inside $OPENHAB_USERDATA/parakeet/

parameter.name: preloadModel
parameter.label: Preload Model
parameter.description: Keep the ASR and VAD models loaded in memory. When enabled, models are only reloaded on configuration changes. When disabled, models are loaded and unloaded on each recognition run.

parameter.name: mode
parameter.label: Transcription Mode
parameter.description: Select the transcription mode. Automatic uses streaming when supported by the model and falls back to offline VAD-segmented batch transcription otherwise.

parameter.name: decoder
parameter.label: Decoder
parameter.description: Decoder used for offline transcription. Leave at Default unless overriding a hybrid model.

parameter.name: language
parameter.label: Language
parameter.description: Target language code (for example, 'en', 'de', 'es', 'fr') for multilingual models that support language selection. Defaults to the recognition locale if empty.

parameter.name: singleUtteranceMode
parameter.label: Single Utterance Mode
parameter.description: When enabled, recognition stops listening after the first utterance completes.

parameter.name: stepSeconds
parameter.label: Audio Step
parameter.description: Audio chunk duration read from the stream in each processing step.

parameter.name: maxSeconds
parameter.label: Max Transcription Seconds
parameter.description: Maximum duration of audio processed in a single recognition session.

parameter.name: initSilenceSeconds
parameter.label: Initial Silence Seconds
parameter.description: Maximum initial seconds of silence before aborting recognition when no speech has started.

parameter.name: maxSilenceSeconds
parameter.label: Max Silence Seconds
parameter.description: Seconds of silence after speech that mark the end of an utterance.

parameter.name: vadModelName
parameter.label: VAD Model Name
parameter.description: Standalone Silero VAD GGUF file inside $OPENHAB_USERDATA/parakeet/. Optional if the main model is a bundle GGUF containing a 'vad' component or when using streaming mode without VAD.

parameter.name: vadThreshold
parameter.label: VAD Threshold
parameter.description: Speech probability threshold (0.05-0.95) for Silero VAD.

parameter.name: minSpeechSeconds
parameter.label: Min Speech Seconds
parameter.description: Minimum duration of speech required to trigger a VAD speech start event.

parameter.name: speechPadSeconds
parameter.label: Speech Padding Seconds
parameter.description: Padding added around speech segments detected by VAD.

parameter.name: threads
parameter.label: Threads per Backend
parameter.description: Number of CPU threads per backend instance (0 uses the library default).

parameter.name: backends
parameter.label: Backends
parameter.description: Number of parallel CPU backend instances configured on the model.
